roadmapLane: P2: explicit backend-connected recovery decision with persistent original-request custody

implementation.change: A retained non-null dispatch intent now makes the combined client recovery status CLIENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, even if a freshly opened local owner has false in-memory uncertainty flags.
implementation.rationale: The existing insert-only intent states POSSIBLY_ATTEMPTED; it does not persist a client response receipt. A cached backend success must not substitute for client-side reconciliation.
implementation.preservedFacts: The exact local original, intent, funding status/revision and uncertainty flags are not rewritten. The exact backend assertion, including CACHED_SUCCESS or ORIGINAL_BINDING_MISMATCH, remains nested in backend.
implementation.semantics: This is an explicit conservative recovery-decision change. Existing historical CACHED_SUCCESS outer-status observations remain historical, not rewritten failures or evidence of a live exploit.
implementation.surfaces: No new exported function, caller capability, transport, backend operation, SQL schema, migration or default application route.
implementation.authority: No read authorizes payment, signing, service dispatch, retry, replacement, re-signing or reset of consumed authority.
implementation.componentReuse: Reuses the existing no-dispatch backend connection and V3 payer/store lifecycle; no second owner, store implementation or close mechanism.

sourceBinding.earlierQualification: The preceding current-main runner and two-process data-only records pin the previous 18,190-byte module. They are preserved, not rerun and not rebound to this changed module.

tests.name: committed intents require reconciliation after native reopen even with false local flags
intent reconciliation preserves exact proof binding and foreign grant fences
no-intent and missing originals remain non-authoritative with unchanged native rows

runtime.digestReuse: Whole runtime digests reused only after all nine physical identity fields matched; no large runtime binary rehash.

launch.environment: env -i with exact owned scratch, twenty source pins and one synthetic opt-in

actualComponents: native V3 payer SQLite store and owned resource
current backend-connected sequential runner used for controlled seeding
durable HTTP session and execution owner used for controlled seeding

declaredComponents.transport: Trusted socketless request/response handles call the actual local backend session. They are not real HTTP/HTTPS/TLS, sockets, network or a provider.
declaredComponents.deadline: A manual monotonic clock and schedule/cancel tokens; not real-time deadlines, cancellation or a capacity benchmark.
declaredComponents.fundingAndActivation: Fixed fake funding pair, fake transaction hash and privileged synthetic V2 activation. The zenon:testnet and MOMENTUM_INCLUDED labels authenticate no chain, current funding, payer/provider/policy or READY.

nativeExecution.capabilityMaterial: Only in-memory synthetic capability keys/proofs. Authorization is absent from custody envelopes and diagnostics; no private key or proof is persisted or exported. Clearing references is not secure memory/string erasure.

coverage.controlledSeed: One custody-only original is retained before dispatch. Two other originals reach the actual local backend through one partial batch; the first response returns, the second drops after backend commit. Both intents are retained and one expected child-unknown root close rejects while its native payer close returns.
coverage.reopenDecision: After normal same-process owned reopen, local submission/custody flags are false and lastTransport is null. Valid original capability proofs read both committed backend successes. The combined status stays CLIENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED for both retained intents; nested CACHED_SUCCESS data stays unchanged.
coverage.proofBinding: A valid synthetic proof for the same request key but changed maxCostUnits remains ORIGINAL_BINDING_MISMATCH in the nested backend result, before any backend original-outcome query. A foreign grant is refused before a query. A subsequent exact proof still returns the recorded backend assertion without clearing reconciliation.
coverage.noIntent: The custody-only original has NO_INTENT_RECORDED and no backend execution, so the unchanged no-intent path returns NOT_RECORDED. This is data, not proof that no operation occurred or permission to execute.
coverage.missingOriginal: A missing local original returns CLIENT_ORIGINAL_NOT_RECORDED with local/backend null and no backend original-outcome query.
coverage.immutableRows: All payer funding, policy, original, intent and schema rows remain equal across the reader open/close except the intentional owner_epoch 2 -> 3. Both file core identities remain stable; backend ledger content is unchanged by all recovery reads.
coverage.close: The no-dispatch reader returns the same cached owned close Promise; its actual native payer close returns once and the resource is RELEASED/DRAINED. The borrowed backend remains usable until its fixture owner closes it.
coverage.limits: This tests normal same-process native reopen, not fresh-process proof recovery, crash/power loss or durable reconstruction of response uncertainty.

storage.cleanup: HOLD: the two child-created raw SQLite files are not registered disposable data.
storage.taskClosure: CLOSED_SUCCESS is distinct from cleanup HOLD.
storage.scratchPrecheckLimit: Read-only pre-admission observation, not an atomic global reservation or OS-enforced quota.

metadataOptimization.previousManifestPrefix: Immutable prior 138-source and 109-private manifest parts are referenced by exact byte/hash/physical-identity pins.
metadataOptimization.comparison: Structural count only: two compact prefix/delta manifests instead of two sets of one core, three source parts and four private parts. The old layout or any earlier test was not rerun for a timing benchmark.
metadataOptimization.noReductionInPinVerification: All 141 protected repository files and all 146 prior private files are fully checked before and after. Referenced rows and delta rows are reconstructed and matched to the complete-cohort seals in independent review.

protectedBoundaries.pr193: Possible VALIDATED exact-same-signed-block resend stays distinct from UNKNOWN and ACKNOWLEDGED. No resend, replacement payment or re-signing was performed or authorized by recovery views.
